commission: Build a background Spotify radio lane in the existing Adam/Home Center Android overlay. Use Shizuku as the background body, target Spotify specifically, create/reuse a rolling playlist, keep the unplayed tail replenished, and accept prompt revisions through the Adam overlay. Do not foreground Spotify, click the phone, use screen automation, generic media keys, phone.open_uri, or substitute another player/engine. During the current source/review phase, perform no phone actions because Drew turned off the interface.

selectedJudgmentJars.reason: Locks background-only Spotify, Shizuku, the existing Adam overlay, and the no-phone/no-foreground exclusions.
Separates repository implementation from Android deployment, Spotify authorization, playback, and physical acceptance.
Forbids merging stale radio branches wholesale or mixing their unrelated overlay and deployment changes into this lane.
Requires exact authority and capability failures instead of falling back to foreground launch or untargeted media keys.

precedents: repository evidence laundered into runtime proof

evidence.finding: Current main has the persistent foreground overlay service and Adam prompt input, but no Spotify-specific controller.
Current app has a special-use foreground service; a persistent background controller can live in the existing app without foregrounding Spotify.
Adam overlay requests already traverse explicit modes and a planned Venice-reviewed worker path; Spotify prompts need a typed deterministic adapter rather than prose execution.

The prior radio controls dispatch generic AudioManager media keys and cannot prove Spotify was targeted. The branch also mixes unrelated overlay and deployment changes and must not be merged wholesale.
The contextual media route uses phone.open_uri / Android VIEW and is explicitly forbidden because it foregrounds an app.
Enumerating active sessions requires MEDIA_CONTENT_CONTROL or enabled notification-listener authority.
Shizuku UserService runs as shell/root, but ADB permissions vary by Android version and must be probed rather than assumed.
Playlist mutation is a Spotify account-plane operation and uses the current /playlists/{playlist_id}/items endpoint.

antagonism.finding: Shizuku being alive does not prove the shell identity can enumerate or control Spotify MediaSessions on this Android build.
antagonism.prevention: Implement a first-class authority probe and fail with SPOTIFY_SESSION_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE. Never fall back to generic media keys, phone.open_uri, Activity launch, or screen automation.

antagonism.finding: Playlist creation, playlist mutation, playback transport, prompt interpretation, overlay presentation, and rolling-tail maintenance are different authority/evidence planes.
antagonism.prevention: Keep typed Spotify account, Shizuku session, Adam planner, rolling policy, and overlay state contracts separate with independent receipts.

antagonism.finding: A background controller could accidentally foreground Spotify during authorization, playback activation, error recovery, or deep-link handling.
antagonism.prevention: Add negative source contracts forbidding Intent ACTION_VIEW, am start, monkey, phone.open_uri, input keyevents, and generic AudioManager dispatch inside the Spotify lane; later physical acceptance must prove foreground package unchanged.

antagonism.finding: Current overlay hide behavior disables remote control. That must not be coupled to playback or rolling-session lifetime.
antagonism.prevention: Store radio state independently and keep the controller alive when the overlay is collapsed/hidden or remote control is disabled.

antagonism.finding: A model-backed endless background loop would be fragile, expensive, and unverifiable.
antagonism.prevention: Use a bounded typed prompt-to-policy step only on explicit prompts; ordinary refills are deterministic and idempotent.

boundedPlan: Create an isolated current-main branch. Do not merge stale PR 249 or PR 258.
Add source-level negative contracts and typed Spotify session/account/rolling receipt schemas first.
Add a Shizuku UserService integration that probes shell UID and exact media-session authority, targets only com.spotify.music, and fails closed without foreground fallback.

Add Spotify account-plane interfaces for one private stable playlist, current playlist-item endpoint use, idempotent snapshot handling, and explicit authorization state. No tokens in overlay state or receipts.
Extend the existing overlay with a Spotify-specific background widget and a Spotify prompt mode that submits through the existing Adam request mechanism.
Compile explicit prompts into spotify.plan.v1; execute only typed operations. Keep the current track unless Drew explicitly requests a skip.
Implement rolling-tail state as a deterministic bounded state machine with duplicate/artist windows, idempotent refill, rate-limit backoff, and no model loop.
Run source contracts and Android build on an authorized non-phone body when available. GitHub Actions are not acceptance evidence.

Do not touch the phone until a later explicitly authorized deployment/acceptance checkpoint. Physical acceptance must prove Spotify never foregrounded, exact package targeting, playlist identity, rolling refill, prompt revision, interface-off continuity, Shizuku fail-closed behavior, and final phone health.
conditions: Shizuku is the commissioned local control body; Spotify Web API is limited to Spotify account/playlist operations and does not replace the body with another player or UI automation.
Spotify App Remote is not an automatic fallback. Introducing it as a control-body substitute requires a separate boundary proposal if the Shizuku authority probe fails.
No phone, Shizuku, overlay, Spotify, or screen action is authorized during the current source-only checkpoint.
No deployment, callability, playback, or acceptance claim may be made from repository changes or source tests.
